events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Early Warning

options.text: Send gifts of thanks for the warning.
Prepare the defenses.
Raise a force of trained volunteers to defend the city.
Why wait?

events.text: The [rival] messenger speaks before the assembled court, warning that their agents have heard of a great host of raiders gathering beyond the edges of the known world in preparation of an attack on [city]. [rival] provides this warning as a sign of their friendship - [city] will be attacked next. How should we use this information?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Family Fury

options.text: Promise to defend [city] to the last.
Focus your attention on attacking the [tribe].
Rally the people to take up arms!

events.text: Raiders are coming, surging towards [city] and destroying all in their path. These unknown warriors have been summoned by the furious [character] of the [tribe], a sworn brother of the distant army’s leader. The elders of [city] beg for your protection against the coming tide. What will we command?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Far Off Nation

options.text: Give them the money.
Prepare our defences!

events.text: The people of [city] are used to tales of the strange, unreachable lands that lie just beyond their borders, but the current rumors have even these hardy folk worried. A great nation far beyond the edges of the known world is said to be gathering its forces to raid our lands. The elders of the city beg for you to give them the funds to attempt to pay off the invaders when they arrive. Shall we accept this request, or shall we defend against the horde?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Friends in Far Places

options.text: [character] is under the protection of [rival].
Very well, take [character] and be gone.

events.text: [character] comes to you in a panic, crying that his past has caught up to him. Before you can even ask what happened, [character] launches into a tale of his younger days exploring, including a year betrothed to the great queen of a nation far beyond the edges of the known world. [character] fled the marriage and thought the matter behind him, but has just received word that this old flame has threatened to send an army to raze [city] unless [character] returns to her side. What message shall you send to this persistent queen?

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Mercenary Raid

options.text: We need archers to defend the city.
Hire their finest riders.
We should not make deals with those who can be bought so easily.

events.text: Word has reached the court that raiders from a distant land are bearing down upon [city]. These warriors from beyond the edges of the known world are mercenaries, wandering armies who fight for the highest bidder and defend the legendary trade routes between their distant nations. But now an unknown paymaster has directed this force at us. Luckily, the loyalty of these troops can be bought, and a number of their commanders have shown themselves willing to fight for us against their own - in return for a steady upkeep.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Raid Redirected

options.text: Pay whatever they ask.
We will not accept these terms.

events.text: Upon hearing of the threat of a distant raid on [city], [character] leaped into action. Riding through the night, he intercepted the oncoming horde and has made a tentative agreement with their leaders. If we pay the far off nation enough tribute then they will attack [city] instead, a chance to weaken our upset neighbors without them ever knowing that we were involved.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Support for the Wicked

options.text: Spare no expense in hunting the traitor down.
The hunt must wait, we should focus on preparing our defenses.

events.text: Wandering through far off lands, [character] has been telling salacious lies about the weakness of our nation, promising various bandits and raiders that [city] is an easy target ripe for the taking. These rumors have spread, until a great host of raiders has been assembled by those hoping to gain riches and plunder from our lands. Even on the run, [character] continues to cause trouble.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: Support for the Wicked

options.text: Spare no expense in hunting the traitor down.
The hunt must wait, we should focus on preparing our defenses.

events.text: Wandering through far off lands, [character] has been telling salacious lies about the weakness of our nation, promising various bandits and raiders that [city] is an easy target ripe for the taking. These rumors have spread, until a great host of raiders has been assembled by those hoping to gain riches and plunder from our lands. Even on the run, [character] continues to cause trouble.

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Monkey Reclaimed

options.text: Return the monkey.
Refuse and take up arms.
The monkey can be returned... for a price.

events.text: Reports abound that there are raiders from far off lands skirting the borders of our nation, pacing like a predator waiting for the perfect moment to strike. But rather than attacking, the leader of the vicious host sends a message, hurriedly relayed to your ears. “Years ago my pet monkey was stolen from me. My spies have told me that it is now in your possession, and they fear me too much to lie. Return my monkey, or face my armies.”

events.author: Josh Unsworth
events.name: The Plight of [city]

options.text: Give them wood for barricades.
Give them food in case of a siege.
[city] needs no further support.

events.text: [city] is under attack. People flee in terror as the raiders sweep through the land, burning and pillaging as they go. [character] comes before you to beg for assistance for the [family] city, describing the atrocities committed by these distant warriors and the sorry state that their previous conquests have been left in. The nobility are attempting to aid the people. Shall the crown lend further help in the face of these attacks?
